# oblique_listing (Resource)

Listing is a collection of resources by role that enable a user-facing view to facilitate access requests. Top level listings describe a service, such as "GitHub", "Salesforce", or "Datadog". Listings then have a set of roles that grant users kinds of access to the service, such as "Viewer", "Editor", or "Admin".

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A listing is a service catalog entry that users can browse and request
# access to (e.g. "GitHub", "Salesforce", "Datadog"). This resource defines
# the listing itself — add oblique_listing_role resources to expose different
# levels of access, and oblique_listing_role_policy resources to control how
# teams can request those roles.
#
# Set `visibility` to "PUBLIC" to make the listing discoverable by all users,
# or "UNLISTED" to hide it from the catalog.
resource "oblique_listing" "github" {
  display_name = "GitHub"
  visibility   = "PUBLIC"
  description  = "Code hosting, version control, and code review"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) A short display name of the listing. For example “GitHub” or “Salesforce”.
- `visibility` (String) Visibility of the listing. When initially created, this should be set to "UNLISTED".

### Optional

- `description` (String) A longer description of the role explaining to the end user what this listing represents, or what users should do once they have access.
- `name` (String) Name of the listing of the format "listings/{id}".

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Create and update timestamps.
- `delete_time` (String) If present, the listing has been deleted and won't be returned in List operations.
- `effective_members_sync_time` (String) The time when the listing's effective members were last recomputed by the effective membership sync.
- `effective_members_update_time` (String) The time when a change was last made that would require the listing's effective members to be recomputed. For example, when an entitlement is created or deleted on a resource that is part of a listing role.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'. This exists to enable Terraform import.
- `management` (Attributes) How this listing is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the calling client. Omitted from responses when the listing is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `update_time` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the resource is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce TERRAFORM; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
